title: diagram spec
description: What a project.json `diagram` scene's `visual.spec` file points to. Consumed by scripts/render/diagram_scene.py, one generic manim.Scene that builds the diagram from this spec -- so a diagram is authored as data, not bespoke manim code.

duration.description: Total seconds the scene holds after its last reveal/highlight step. Purely a manim-side pacing hint -- assemble_project.py still pads/truncates the rendered clip to whatever timing.py actually assigned the scene from narration.

id.description: Referenced by edges' from/to and by reveal/highlight step ids.

icon.description: Optional single Nerd Font glyph (brand.yaml typography.diagram_family), prepended to the label as a simple thin-line pictogram -- no separate SVG asset needed.

position.description: manim coordinate space (~14.2 units wide for a 16:9 frame at default zoom), not pixels.

style.description: solid for a physical/data connection, dashed for wireless/tunneled.

direction.description: Which end(s) get an arrowhead. 'none' is an explicit opt-out for a passive physical link -- edges always show a direction otherwise.

reveal.description: Timed entrance order. Each step fades in the listed node/edge ids (edge id = "<from>-><to>") at the given time.

highlight.description: Timed accent flashes (brand.yaml palette.accent) on a single node/edge id -- the same visual cue captions already use for "the word being said right now".
